declarations.name: LuzBanner
declarations.description: CSS-only: no script defines this tag. One announcement above the header, with an optional link.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: A yellow band and a darker rule; the words say it too.

declarations.name: LuzLangSwitch
declarations.description: CSS-only: no script defines this tag. A button that opens a popover with one link per language; the links are the switcher.

declarations.name: LuzSubmenu
declarations.description: CSS-only: no script defines this tag. An item of a header's links that opens a native details with more links.

declarations.name: LuzConsent
declarations.description: A cookie banner that asks once, stores the answer on the device and tells the page with an event.

attributes.name: data-luz-consent
attributes.description: On the section inside the element: the banner itself; hidden until a choice is due.

attributes.name: data-luz-consent-ask
attributes.description: On the block with the question and the buttons; it gives way to the confirmation.

attributes.name: data-luz-consent-done
attributes.description: On the confirmation block, hidden until a choice is saved; it takes focus.

attributes.name: data-luz-consent-close
attributes.description: On the confirmation's Close button: it hides the banner.

attributes.name: data-luz-consent-open
attributes.description: On a button anywhere on the page: it shows the banner again with the stored choice; hidden until the script works.

attributes.name: data-luz-consent-key
attributes.description: On the banner: the storage key, which must start with "luz-"; "luz-consent" by default.

attributes.name: data-luz-consent-days
attributes.description: On the banner: days a choice lasts, 180 by default and 395 at most.

events.name: luz:consent
events.description: On document when a choice is saved; detail is { asked, granted, expires } (category names and a time in ms).

declarations.name: LuzMode
declarations.description: Core's color mode radios with an Auto state that follows the system or the clock of the day; it stores the choice on request.

attributes.name: remember
attributes.description: Store the chosen mode under core's luz-theme key; Auto removes it. Without it nothing is stored.

attributes.name: by
attributes.description: What Auto follows: the local hour, which also writes the light attribute; without it (or by="system") the system's preferences.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: The id of the element that gets data-theme and the light attribute; the default is <html>.

attributes.name: light-attr
attributes.description: The name of the attribute for the phase of the day, a data-* name; the default is data-light.

events.name: luz-mode:change
events.description: Bubbles from the element after the upgrade and on every change, with detail { mode, theme, light, remembered, simulated }.

declarations.name: LuzSearch
declarations.description: A button that opens a dialog which finds a page, a section or an HTML element of the site by name, from a JSON index.

attributes.name: data-luz-search-src
attributes.description: On the dialog: the JSON index of the site, on the same origin; links in it are relative to the file.

attributes.name: data-luz-search-show
attributes.description: On a block of the dialog: the state that shows it (idle, none); the others are hidden.

attributes.name: data-luz-search-list
attributes.description: On a list of the dialog: the group of results it receives.

attributes.name: data-luz-search-results
attributes.description: On the block that holds the groups; the arrow keys move between its links.

attributes.name: data-luz-search-open
attributes.description: On a button, in the element or anywhere on the page: it opens the dialog; hidden until the script works.

attributes.name: data-luz-search-fallback
attributes.description: On the link to the A-Z index: it shows until the script works, then the trigger takes its place.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-idle
attributes.description: What the status says while the field is empty.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-loading
attributes.description: What the status says while the index loads.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-error
attributes.description: What the status says when the index could not be loaded.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-none
attributes.description: What the status says when nothing matches; {query} is the text typed.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-result
attributes.description: What the status says for one result; {n} is the count.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-results
attributes.description: What the status says for several results; {n} is the count.

attributes.name: data-luz-label-capped
attributes.description: What the status says when more results match than are shown; {n} is the count and {shown} the number listed.
